findings.claim: The switch's onCheckedChange always dispatches setOverride, even when the new value equals the config value, so toggling a row off and back on leaves it in an overridden state that merely happens to match the current chain instead of returning to a clean, non-overridden state. Users relying on the switch as their primary control will accumulate silent overrides that are indistinguishable from normal config values except via the 'matchesCurrentChain' indicator.

The editor's configValue and chainScope fields reflect the raw config-service data, not the overridden value used by useHasFeature, creating an intentional but undocumented split between what the 'Config service' column shows and what the switch below it controls; this should be documented with a comment explaining the distinction.

The check icon uses visibility: hidden combined with an aria-label, but visibility: hidden removes the element from the accessibility tree, so a screen reader never announces the match state, and the actual accessible content lives inside TooltipContent which is only exposed on focus or hover; either add sr-only text alongside the visible check or drop the aria-label on the icon since the tooltip content already provides the announcement.

featureFlagOverridesSlice's reducer is registered unconditionally and included in persistedSlices and broadcastState even in production, where applyFeatureOverrides is a no-op; this means a stale featureFlagOverrides localStorage entry from prior use on the same origin will silently persist in production with no UI available to clear it.

The marker string 'local feature-flag overrides' used in the bundle exclusion test is generic enough that an unrelated future copy change could accidentally satisfy or invalidate the assertion; a longer, editor-specific sentinel string or a dedicated data attribute would make the test more robust.
There is no unit test for FeatureFlagEditor covering the search filter, the enable/disable and dispatch behavior of 'Reset all overrides', or the empty overridden section.
There is no unit test for FeatureFlagSection verifying it returns null when rows.length is 0.

There is no test covering applyFeatureOverrides when a chain has an override for a feature that is not present in the Chain['features'] enum type; the cast to string is safe but lacks a coverage anchor.
The empty span used as an alignment spacer relies on an existing grid comment for context and could be lost or misunderstood in future edits without more explicit annotation.
Sorting is performed inline with localeCompare on every render even though FEATURES is a fixed enum; alphabetizing once at module scope would avoid repeated re-sorting.

selectOverrideCount subscribes the sidebar to the store in production even though the feature-flag group is hidden there, causing an unnecessary (if cheap) subscription; hoisting the IS_PRODUCTION check above useAppSelector would avoid this at the cost of a conditional-hook pattern.
